title: Gears Within Gears

reward.description: A coil that never quite stops unwinding. Looking at it too long makes you dizzy.

hints: Every recursive function needs a base case: an input so small you know the answer right away (an empty list, n == 1...).
For count_cogs, loop over the items. If an item is a list (isinstance(item, list)), add count_cogs(item); otherwise add 1.
blueprint_depth of a list is 1 + the biggest depth of any list inside it. A list with no lists inside has depth 1.
